79890.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum's path to 2030
79890.body:
Vitalik Buterin maps how Ethereum will change by 2030 | Strategy buys another $143 million of bitcoin | Bitget starts restoring withdrawals after $388 million exploit | Tom Lee's Bitmine tops 6 million ETH | Analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single operation

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented By:

( https://thezcashetf.com/?utm_campaign=website-traffic-zcsh-newsletters--2026-08-25&utm_medium=paid-other&utm_source=the-block&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Monday! *Bitcoin* is trading nearly around $83,500, with crypto markets losing some steam after the recent rally as fresh macro uncertainty puts pressure on risk assets.

In today's newsletter, *Vitalik Buterin* maps Ethereum's path to 2030, *Strategy* buys another $143 million of bitcoin, *Tom Lee's Bitmine* tops 6 million ETH, *Bitget* starts restoring withdrawals, and more.

Meanwhile, SEC Commissioner *Hester Peirce* reflects ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-09-28-sec-commissioner-hester-peirce-reflects-what-she-wanted-get-done-no-good-time-to-leave-417075?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) on her time at the agency with The Block, *Citi* *expands* ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-09-28-citi-coinbase-stablecoin-payments-corporate-clients-417082?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) *its Coinbase partnership* for stablecoin payments, and Strive adds another $94.5 million of bitcoin.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out The Latent ( https://thelatent.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) , our new sister website covering AI. Get *The Latent Daily* here ( https://thelatent.co/newsletter?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) and *all other The Block newsletters* here ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

*THE BIG ONE*

*⚙️ Vitalik Buterin maps how Ethereum will change by 2030*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2026-09-27-its-really-not-just-a-blockchain-anymore-vitalik-buterin-maps-ethereums-path-to-2030-416953?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin* laid out how Ethereum's architecture will change by 2030, describing it as "really not just a blockchain anymore" but a combination of blockchain design and modern cryptography.

* Buterin said *Hegota* , the upgrade planned for next year, is likely to be Ethereum's last "normal" fork, with later upgrades involving recursive STARKs, automated formal verification, highly optimized consensus algorithms and *quantum-safe cryptography*.
